Candidates who resort to violence while participating in protests or movements in Uttar Pradesh could be barred from government jobs under a new recruitment policy introduced by the Yogi Adityanath government. The policy also allows provisional appointments before character verification is completed, while making detailed background checks mandatory for sensitive posts. Candidates involved in serious cases will not be eligible for government jobs. Watch the video to know more.
